summary: The renderer passes the pixel and output checks. T2 can test a different checkout or render an unowned fixture. Both defects block phase acceptance.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: tests/render-options.test.ts:7-15,55-69 hard-codes the render checkout and the wrapper path. A different checkout can get a green result for this worktree's renderer. Resolve the checkout from the test module and configure the required wrapper without an owner-specific path.

F2 [Blocker] review-a: tests/render-options.test.ts:64-70,192-218 bypasses the exclusive create when the real fixture path exists. The test sends that unowned file to Forge instead of reporting `fixture path exists: <path>`. The collision probe tests a different path and creates it without `wx`. Exercise the real path and confirm that a collision starts no render.
nonblocking_findings: F3 [Nit] review-a: src/cli/forge.ts:46-54 says `--ortho` is level and `--focus` zooms every view. src/render/page.ts:430-449 keeps the selected elevation and ignores focus in orthographic mode. Document these limits or reject incompatible options before the build.
F4 [Nit] review-a: tests/render-options.test.ts:86-97,153-159 measures two empty masks as one pixel each. Other cases still reject blank PNGs. Require a nonempty mask in the height case itself.

F5 [Nit] review-a: c69a5b73 changed a test despite the Green brief. The edit updates three exact line pins only and leaves the T2 Red test intact. Record it as a reviewed role-scope deviation in plan.md:250-255.

F6 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:185-186 says both changes are restored. src/render/page.ts:430-463 restores the materials and ground, not the camera. State which state is restored and which camera settings each caller sets.

F7 [Nit] review-a: A5 at plan.md:235-237. Both exact snapshots report 51 type errors in 14 files, not 13. The pre-existing Storytime guard accounts for 13 errors beyond TD-35 to TD-39. Correct the evidence without making full tsc a gate.
evidence: HEAD matches audited_head_sha. The phase base is its ancestor.
An isolated probe ran the committed fixture logic with a pre-existing real fixture path and observed a Forge call on the foreign source.
The alternate-checkout probe shows the committed test selects the original worktree and the fixed wrapper path.
T1 has 15 passing tests at the phase base. At HEAD, its three hero tests pass and 15 scrapped tests skip.
The HEAD scanner passes. The scanner with old pins fails at exactly the three moved Box3.union calls.
Reversing only the scanner's line pins, indices, and explanatory comment recreates the old scanner byte for byte. The T2 test blob is unchanged from d02c8fa9.
Wrapped HEAD Vitest exits 0: 14 files pass, 2 files skip; 84 tests pass, 15 tests skip. The 84 passing tests include all 8 T2 cases and 73 existing render-related tests.
The fresh 256 × 256 PNGs have transparent corners and equal mask rows 12 to 243. Front body RGBA is [63,143,208,255], and the block is [224,160,48,255].
The side PNG has edge alpha and the +Z landmark in columns 99 to 109. Studio.aim projects its centre to column 104.727273 using decision (j).

Wrapped sprout-pip renders and sprites from isolated phase-base and HEAD snapshots have matching SHA-256 sums for all 16 deliverables. render.png matches 7efc9c271626c597bd542d72e4ea9d0bc9949f3b031cef0baacb1a190cba7b23.
Wrapped tsc exits 2 at both commits. The 51 diagnostics in 14 files match after normalizing the temporary snapshot path. No diagnostic names a changed file.
The flat-material probe verifies retained geometry and visibility, full coverage opacity, and exact material and ground restoration.
The CLI preflight probe rejects missing fast, missing background, and an opaque background with the exact named error before asset lookup or Vite.
A3: Counts came from labeled Vitest reporter lines and exact file/count pairs from grep -Hc.
A4: The PNG case rejects a successful subprocess that produced no PNGs. The Measure doctor check rejects a registered track with no plan.
A4: The isolated height case accepts two fully transparent images. The other pixel tests reject those images.
A5: The T1, T2, and existing test counts match the plan. The type-check file count and debt attribution do not.
The AC1 audit guard rejects the phase base and a missing test file. The persistent guard remains scheduled for T4.
build-graph affected reports only the renderer page and CLI. git grep confirms the CLI passes the optional ViewsRequest fields to the page.

test_strategy_violations: F1: The T2 test can render a different checkout from the checkout under test.
F2: The real pin path can bypass the collision rule in test-strategy.md:84-96.

ratings.evidence: The flat pixel and material probes pass, but src/render/page.ts:430-449 ignores focus under orthographic projection.
All eight T2 cases pass locally, but tests/render-options.test.ts:64-70 bypasses the collision check on the real path.
Commit c69a5b73 exceeded the Green test scope only to update three existing scanner line pins.
The replays match all output hashes, but plan.md:235-237 understates the number of files with baseline type errors.
